promises.label: EHV capacity on stream by end of calendar year
promises.quote: EHV is very much on track. Capacity is expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year.
promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: EHV revenue contribution in FY28
promises.quote: in FY28 revenues, we can see some contribution from EHV capacity because it's a tender-based business
promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: volume growth 1.5x GDP growth full year
promises.quote: we've always guided, we'll continue to deliver 1.5x of GDP growth
promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: 90% of Project Spring capex into Cable & Wire
promises.quote: around 90% of that will go into Cable & Wire capacity expansion alone. And some 5% will go into backward integration
promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.label: FY26 volume growth 18%
reported.quote: 18% volume growth, which has resulted in a market share gain of around 3% to 4% in this financial year alone

reported.label: FY26 company EBITDA margin 13.9%
reported.quote: Overall full year EBITDA at company level is 13.9% and Cable & Wire was definitely above that

reported.label: Q4 FY26 Cable & Wire EBITDA margin 14%+
reported.quote: for the fourth quarter it was higher. So definitely around 14%, 14-plus percent

reported.label: Q4 institutional mix 13-14% of top line
reported.quote: if I say 3% to 4%, you can make it 13% to 14% for the quarter

reported.label: Solar delivered 2x growth over last year
reported.quote: solar, of course, continues to be the strong driver, delivering 2x of growth over last year
